title: RCMDM 3rd BoD Meeting RY 2026-27
summary: The 3rd Board of Directors meeting of RCMDM in RY 2026-27 was held jointly with the 6th Regular Speaker meeting on Saturday 26th September 2026 at the Hall in Purandare Hospital…
description: The 3rd Board of Directors meeting of RCMDM in RY 2026-27 was held jointly with the 6th Regular Speaker meeting on Saturday 26th September 2026 at the Hall in Purandare Hospital hosted by Rtn. Dr. Anuja and Dr. Shekahr Purandare at their hospital at Chowpatty, Marine Drive, Mumbai, 5pm onwards. BoD meeting was chaired and called to order by President Nayan Rawal. Notice. agenda and previous minutes were circulated by email, earlier. All items on agenda were discussed and deliberated and approved and adopted unanimously. Light snacks and tea were served to all present. 18 RCMDM members attended.
